notes.title: S5 Season [Strange Meeting Alice] Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/73009272e8e3b2155b0e16fc23feb4752ca0d89b.jpg[/img]

[Adventure Mode
Night of Wishes New Profession [Florist
The mysterious girl who was half plant, half human - the Florist woke up in the midst of a violent tremor. She vaguely remembers that the moment the Sky Country fell, strange magic wrapped around her body, and then she fell into a long sleep. Upon awakening again, chirpy plant companions led the florist to the place. The remnants of the kingdom glory around the tip of her nose, perhaps this cave can help the florist find the truth of the time ......
Added 107 new cards, including 23 new Attendants*, 26 new Equipment cards*, and 58 new Action cards*.
Added new leader monster [Cave True].

Adventure Mode Discount Season
2024.9.20-9.30, all Adventure Mode Collection Packs are half price (except for the new profession Florist).
The [Profession Optional Card] included in the First Charge Pack allows you to pick the Spirit Tuner DLC.


[Online Mode
I. Gameplay changes
1. New Playstyle
Dance partner gameplay is temporarily offline, and new mission gameplay is now available! On the 4th turn of the game, pick a mission and complete it to receive a [Chance] reward that brings benefits to the game.
The difficulty of the mission is related to a number of factors: the higher the strength of the encounter, the stronger the match between the hero and the encounter or mission, the less gold the hero has in the opening round, and the more favorable the camp of the game is to the encounter or mission -> the higher the difficulty of the mission.

2.Rule Adjustment
Dynamic balance of hero's opening gold
The opening gold amount of some heroes will change dynamically according to the camp. For example, a hero with 1-4 coins will have 4 coins in the game with the most unfavorable camp, and 1 in the game with the most favorable camp. the camp's value of the hero's opening coins is based on the player's actual game data.
Refresh Protection
When refreshing the store, it will reduce the chance of appearance of cards recently swiped away by the player. This adjustment is to optimize the search efficiency when players spend a lot of gold to search for cards.
Break Defense Compensation
The first time a player's life value falls below 16, they will receive 1 spell card that allows them to pick 5-6 star spells. If there are no more than 4 players left, any remaining players who have not received this bonus will also receive it. This adjustment is intended to give players who are at a massive disadvantage early on more means to stabilize the battle.
Damage Mechanism Modification
When a hero deals damage, the calculated star level of each follower that calculates damage will not exceed the store level of the player from whom the damage originated.
Other adjustments are detailed in the in-game announcement

3. Hero Changes
New Heroes
Alice】Walking in Wonderland Passive : At the start of the battle, pick 1 mission.
Queen of Hearts] Chop off his head! 3 Gold Remove 1 card, pick 1 +1 starred card
Mad Hatter] Craft a Hat Passive : When upgrading, pick 1 Hat
Bowler Hat Make 1 follower gain +1+1 and Shield. Return this spell when you sell that follower.
Feathered Hat Make 1 follower gain +1+1 and Madness. Return this spell when you sell this follower.
Cowboy Hat Gives 1 follower +3+3 and Taunt. Return this spell when you sell this follower.
Gothic Hat Gives +1+1 to 1 follower and Last Word: Summon 1 original copy of yourself. Return this spell when you sell this follower.
Sorcerer's Hat Gives +1+1 and 2 levels of damage increase to 1 follower. Return this spell when you sell this follower.
Straw Hat Enables 1 follower to gain +1+1 and Growth: +2+2. Return this spell when you sell this follower.
Mr. White Rabbit] Haste 2 gp: Immediately take 1 additional turn of the same number of turns (Time is running out!) .. Limit 2 per game
【Dessert Merchant】Dessert Peddling Passive: Gain 1 gold after you use a spell card
Other hero adjustments are detailed in the in-game announcement

4. Attendant adjustments, equipment card changes, spell card changes, see in-game announcement for details

II. Anniversary Events
Celebrate the anniversary with a full moon. To celebrate the 7th anniversary of the launch of Full Moon, click on the Activity Center in the game and participate in the anniversary activities to get a number of rewards!

III. System Functions
New Season
S5 season theme: Alice. The new season journey opens, a mysterious blue mist shrouds the Mirror Arena - Alice, the girl who fell from the sky, has changed the Mirror Arena with her magical power...
Purchasing a Season Pass Reward will earn you the following rewards: Mirror Spirit [Tiny Florist], Exclusive Chessboard, New Strike Effects, New Hero Skin, New Chess Skin, New Avatar Frame, New Emoticon, Alice in Wonderful Encounters Collectible Chess Box, and Pumpkin Coins.
Purchasing a Premium Pass will give you additional rewards: pass level upgrade, quest experience bonus, Classic Series [Wind Dancer] chess piece skin, [Little Florist] 30-day experience card, new mirror spirit, new emoticon, and the Alice in Wonderland Collection Chess Box.
Main Interface
New S5 season [Alice in Wonderland] main interface.
In the lobby of online mode, you can display the mirror spirit in battle, and click on the mirror spirit model to play the mirror spirit's action.
Optimized the animation when entering a game from the main interface.
Personal Information
Added a new collection showroom.
Added Mirror Spirit Scroll.
Event Center
Added New Star Chess Player Recruitment Event.
Added S5 Season Limited Gift Pack.
Collectible Chess Box
The mischievous Alice has transformed the Mirror Arena into a wonderland, and this season, she has selected 64 pieces for you and put them in the Collector's Chess Box, and you can get the corresponding chess frames when you open the S5 Season [Alice's Encounter] Collector's Chess Box.
The more frames you collect, the more you reach the collection progress, and the more rewards you can get: new avatars, new avatar frames, the Alice in Wonderland collection box, and the exclusive mirror spirit [Alice in Wonderland in the Mirror - Little Alice].
You can switch seasons on the Collectible Skin interface to view the details of the special effects played on the current or historical season's Collectible Skin.
Added Pieces Proficiency Ranking, which is based on the proficiency of some of the pieces in the Collectible Chess Box.
Chess Box Progress.
Historical season's box progress, collectible box props, and unused box ingredients will be retained.
You can select the historical season (starting from S4 season) in the piece advancement interface, and perform advancement, decomposition, and synthesis operations on the frames of that season to complete camp tasks and obtain progress rewards.
You can continue to use the historical season's treasured chess box, exclusive chess frames and other resources. When you open the treasure box, you can choose to open the treasure box of the current season or the historical season to extract the corresponding frame. 
Mall System
S5 Season Daily Free Chests have been changed to be used immediately after purchase. Note: Free Chests obtained in S4 Season still need to be opened manually in the backpack.
For other new additions, please refer to the in-game announcement.
Summoning System
The [Mystery of Mirror] pool will be closed on 2024.9.20, and the remaining mirror value will expire after the pool is closed. The expired Mirror Value will be automatically converted to a certain percentage of Pumpkin Coins, which will be automatically distributed via email.
New Summoning Prize Pool: Bright Moon Draped.
New Summoning Pool: Black Forest Songstress.

notes.title: Version update announcement: 'The Wishing Night' is here!
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm Little Red Riding Hood on the journey again:
The Wishing Night has finally arrived amidst the overwhelming calls from card masters.
Thanks to the encouragement and support of the card masters! The update of the PC version of "The Wishing Night" contains two new modes, thus doubling the workload of the port ,therefore the the launch of this new version has been delayed. We sincerely apologize to the long-awaited card masters! Now, the new version is finally on! 

We love and cherish the "Classic Mode" as much as every player. "The Wishing Night" is a new game mode derived from the classic mode. It is gratifying to see that, through the feedback of several early tests, most players can feel the fun of playing card construction from the new game. At the same time, in the "Memory in Mirror " mode, we also launched the two new camps alchemist, believers, and toy theme levels. We hope the addition of new content can bring more challenges and inspiration for card masters.

New mode - Wishing Night
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/fe494a0939f4c67aad9e57c34584283c58b497d2.jpg[/img]
A mysterious map leads to a fantastic adventure in a cave
Some people believe that it is alive. On every lunar eclipse night, this behemoth will awaken from its slumber and take the form of people's innermost hidden longing, luring you step by step toward the abyss. Many adventurers have followed the magic map to the underground caves in search of the legend, God of Wishes, and have heard nothing since then.

The main line returns and Little Red Riding Hood embarks on another journey
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/81308f168b0ded7ad8c4d14d871b4c175b7c0455.png[/img]
After the destruction of the Forest Spirit, Little Red Riding Hood is convinced that the young carpenter has not disappeared, running around to find out the news.
A strange map arrives quietly, pointing to a mysterious cave. The scribble on it reads, '' In the deep cave lives the guardian god who can grant wishes. Just make a wish religiously and your wish will come true.''
The night of the lunar eclipse is the only time to open the entrance to the cave. Despite Little Red Riding Hood feeling strange, she still decided to go to the cave to investigate ......

The world expands. A mysterious character shows
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/3bec003b8a36c5a988a2b4d4c4a5099581198f82.png[/img]
A woman comes from a mysterious kingdom.
The young king suddenly got sick. She tried every way but nothing works out to save the young king. She could only watch her beloved king weakening day by day. The sudden arrival of a mysterious map reminds the queen that making a wish may be the only way to save the king.
On a night when the moon disappears, the queen embarks on a journey to make a wish for the king, and she seems to forget that this is her second wish journey ......

Upgraded gameplay, 265 new cards to enjoy the fun of matching
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/4341115e5801c86790c65c39aa1969cd00364324.png[/img]
1. Recruit partners with different effects to organize an adventure team
2. Use the equipment to strengthen the partner's combat power and create a variety of chain reactions
3. Sharpen your combat skills, the decision to play cards, in turn, is crucial.
4. Plan the gold and route. Every step in the adventure has to be carefully calculated.

New scenes, 73+ enemies waiting to be challenged
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/644d0e8d1142450487c767506627f02f70a1712b.png[/img]

Version update - Memory in Mirror

Two new camps 
Alchemist and Acolyte have now joined Memory in Mirror
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/00384c4eb3ad0873c6dc0a5f289ffaac955b0ff7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/d88f4356519e1065e6c74e281fa31412773e0098.png[/img]
The 8 camps can be matched at will, what kind of inspiration will the card masters inspire?

New toy theme level
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/3d50049e59ea005930b1127883a4fd7821a1c658.png[/img]
After Black Swan recovered her memories from the Mirror Witch, she ran deeper into the Mirror World in order to find the key to leaving this world. After pushing open the next door, she seems to have come to the world of ...... toys?
The little girl who forgot her beloved toys was the superstar of toys; the Nutcracker soldier majestically guarded the next door; the wolf doll seemed to look somewhat familiar. Oh, the Royal Tinkerer seems to have revealed a secret!

Operation experience optimization
1. Add the "Skip" button. When all the enemies are dead, you can click the button to skip the remaining animation.
2. Add the "View" button, and click the "magnifying glass" icon at the bottom left corner of the battle interface. You can quickly view the current star, camp and equipment of each partner party.

Classic mode optimization
Now, card masters can select the mode they want to play directly from the bookshelf interface.
2. New cards: After the last enhancement of the Werewolf, the Werewolf profession now can have 5 new cards.
3. New Blessing: Classic mode Ranger, Little Witch, and Apothecary get new blessings [Random Strain]: When cards are generated in battle, their consumption is halved.
4. Achievement View: Now when viewing the history deck, card icon, and monster story, it will automatically switch to the currently selected mode.

notes.title: 【Update Notes】Soul Hunter comes into the Dark Woods
notes.notes:
1．New Role-Soul Hunter
Soul hunter is added as a new role under the classic mode—the quiet and taciturn Little Red-hood, secret forces and a brand-new mechanic.
Sign a contract with Death. Do you have the guts?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/93b114bee5a3b2aa510ba2ec67ffdd93781174e3.jpg[/img]
 
２．New Role-Ranger
Ranger is newly added as a reset role under the Little Red-Hood Diary mode. Players having unlocked “the Little Red-Hood Diary” will be able to unlock this new role for free. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/44562de8b3a34611ff9dae00df57c12add07c9df.jpg[/img]

3. Big Change to Little Red-Hood Diary

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/79b014166c7be2f4c2ec6bee56665d62f3497939.jpg[/img]

3.1
Hard 1-5 is added for Little Red-Hood Diary mode. The increasing hard level will bring greater challenges to card masters

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/c743136498e604e5a940c5b8e5c6b83400dbcaf3.jpg[/img]
 
3.2　
Little Red-Hood Diary will get extra ability cards dropped after defeating the monster under the hard mode. Ability cards can be divided into such 3 types as giving exploring skills, giving initial blessing or special card. 
After getting an ability card, the player can use it by equipping it in corresponding ability bar in new adventure preparation stage. The ability bar will be unlocked after clearing the first 3 stages in hard mode.

3.3　
A skip button is added for the normal mode, which allows to skip current monster and restore some blood volume with the price of missing the gift from the monster. 
It should be noted that you cannot skip the Elites and Boss since they guard the major routes of various areas. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/3878f6d71ec38094b52b31eb7f2d56c2256f8930.jpg[/img]
 

3.4
Little Red-Hood Diary extends the gaming procedure of hard mode. Comparing with normal mode, it has more monsters and events. 
Now, you have more chances to form your own deck and enjoy the infinite pleasure brought by an infinite deck. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/75f6a76b7aa1453198826d2f7478693e070e0402.jpg[/img]
 
3.5
In hard mode, you will not get fixed initial deck and equipment at the very beginning. You need to start new adventures with a set of universal cards after selecting cards for 2 times. 

4.　New Monsters
Butterfly Guard, Portrait, Primeape, Lady bush, Moonkin Prophet...you will meet over 10 new monsters in further exploration of the castle. There are two new Bosses: cyclops giant and Donkey-eared King, who are especially tough to tackle with. Danger!

5.　New Cards
Over 100 cards are added for the new version (the Soul Hunter under classic mode and Ranger under Little Red Hood Diary mode), bringing new experiences for card masters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/7e2f2401074bd51500e3c3364bf6bd7a5143a727.jpg[/img]
 
6.　New Events
6 events are newly added. Your choice matters. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/65b21c2897f8cdf8125abe6d0c6079875fd0dc2b.jpg[/img]

7.　New Scenarios
2 brand-new scenarios are newly added. Follow the black swan to explore unknown areas with the Little Red Hood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/c4b689bfbb7abf4f454dea7e8394854b0ec0bb5e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/7f2903713e0f2a8c2c4eec63b2d545a1c5a09880.jpg[/img]

8.　New Stories
In the last version, the secret Black Swan took the young carpenter with it, and the Little Red Hood went on the cause of finding the young carpenter. This time, she heads toward the deeper place of the castle. What awaits her? 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34776062/b9850e2af3d618bf57ec64e4852fd6e92718d60a.jpg[/img]

9.　New contents added for Memory Puzzle-without charging more
New puzzles are added for Memory Puzzle. Wait, why are they different with previous puzzle? It seems like the method of clearing the stage before is no longer works.

10.　Experience Optimization
 Efforts have been paid to make it easier for players to construct decks. 
10.1 Optimization of blessing
10.1.1 Adjust the copy effect of blessing [Magic Statue] to copy 1 card.
10.1.2 Adjust the effect of blessing [Make the Same] to copy 1 card to the deck.
10.1.3 Delete blessing [Telescope].
10.1.4 Adjust the effect of blessing [Mirror Illusion] to add an extra Prank card.
10.1.5 Adjust the effect of blessing [Bloodletting] to reduce maximum health.
10.1.6 Adjust the maximum health to be reduced with blessing [Heavy Treasure Box] from 5 to 8
10.1.7 Adjust the effect of blessing [Swiftness] to last for 1 turn. 
10.1.8 Blessing [Forbidden Enchantment] Equipment slot gained-1
10.1.9 Blessing [Jeweled Dagger] is removed from the blessing pool.
10.1.10 Blessing [Anger Aroused] Change “more effectable” to “rage amount gained in each turn +1”

10.2 Optimization of Monsters
10.2.1 Monster [Sword in Stone] Adjust to “could not be met by Ranger”. Card masters who farm for gold could give up. 
10.2.2 Monster [Bear Mage] Weaken deck strength
10.2.3 Monster [Demoness] Add exile effect for interfere card in the deck. 
10.2.4 Monster [Rat King] No Survival Boat before grade 3. 
10.2.5 Monster [Wolf King] Adjust the deck to make it more consistent with the characteristics of the role of Wolf King
10.2.6 Monster [Grandma] Reduce the amount of deck. 
10.2.7 The hypnotizing effect of [Sleepless Sheep] and [Hypnotist] are weakened to “exile, enemy lose 2 actions”

10.3 Optimization of cards
10.3.1 Card [Quick Memory] Apothecary, Knight and Magician could not get. 
10.3.2 Interfere cards like [Freeze, Drained] could be discarded from cards in your hand at the end of a turn. 
10.3.3 The effect triggered when [Sleeping Wind Knight] and Blessing [Toy box] are interconnected is adjust from “generate 2 equipment” to “generate 1equipment, turn to wind knight and then make the wind knight deal damage.” 
10.3.4 Card [Float] cannot trigger yourself. 
10.3.5 Card [Toy Spear] Reduce the value by 2 points.
10.3.6 Card [Heavy Fog] Reduce the number of turns for which it can last to 1; increase the dodging rate by 10%. 
10.3.7 Card [Hemorrhage] Action can not be restored. 
10.3.8 Card [Hunger] Add the attribute of “a card can be drawn”. 
10.3.9 Adjust the double effect of [Bard] to “won’t last for the entire fight”
10.3.10 Card [Echo] Decrease +1
10.3.11 Change [Awaiting Orders] and [Feint] to action card with 0 decrease to make them more suitable for Rangers. 

10.4 Optimization of events
10.4.1 Event [Peri's Whisper] is removed temporarily. 
10.4.2 The exchange times of event [Card Collector] is reduced by one; the rate of giving good card is increased.

notes.title: Devspeak-About the upcoming update
notes.notes:
Dear NoFM Players,

We are very sorry! Since the release of NoFM on steam, there are many Bugs. Through our troubleshooting and verification, we find 3 main bugs:

1.Open Game but find the record；
2.Purchase DLC but still locked；
3.Abnormal Paying Method；

If you met bugs above, sorry for the inconvenience. We have found the solutions for them and will try best to release a new build within Today. Please re-download the game then. 

Besides, some players also reported other issues. Here are our suggestions: 

Black Screen：Please uninstall the game completely and then re-download the game. 
Network Error：Please restart steam client. 

Please accept our apology for above issues. Thank you for your support. We will update the game soon.

PS: This is the first we release game on steam and we are inexperienced at many steps during uploading build. Hence there were many unexpected issues after the release. We sincerely accept all your reports and suggestions and seize the time to fix them.  Sorry for any inconvenience caused by above issues.
